summary: Vasquez voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, incorporating the IHRA definition into Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. That vote places him in support of a framework that equates anti-Zionism with antisemitism in educational settings. A 2024 JStreet PAC priority endorsement further situates him in the pro-Israel bloc of the House.
